Native: 12-bell-bearing-soldier.pcraft
Bearded adult with steel brimmed helmet, metal cuirass, quilted brown sleeves, dark breeches and boots; pole-mounted brass bell and braced lifting pose.
Required: Pole lift/ring/recover drawings with separate rigid bell, suspension and free clapper; hand/pole contact; helmet and armor occlusion surfaces.
Unapproved historical reference. No separated joints, rig, pose registration or motion approval.
